title: Alkoholisierter Mann schlägt Nachbarn, greift Polizeibeamte an und leistet Widerstand bei Festnahme – DEIG-Einsatz

extraction.summaryEn: A 44-year-old man struck his 40-year-old neighbour with a key ring in a residential building, then resisted arrest and was hit with a conducted energy device (DEIG) by police. Officers were unhurt; the couple were taken for blood tests and released.
